outcome: Childhood allergy (eczema, asthma, food allergy, allergic rhinoconjunctivitis)
cohort: 65 children living in the same rural area of south-west Sweden
finding: While 19 cord blood metabolites were found to be related to future allergy diagnosis, perinatal factors such as birth order, sex, and mode of delivery had a greater impact on several energy and biosynthetic pathways.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to affect glyoxylate and dicarboxylic acid metabolism (p = 0.005).
